LanguageData.ZEN_CherryWood.label: cherry wood
LanguageData.ZEN_CherryWood.description: Wood from cherry trees. Useful for building structures, weapons, and even simple prosthetics. A raw stick of cherrywood can be used as a weapon in a pinch.
LanguageData.ZEN_EbonyWood.label: ebony wood
LanguageData.ZEN_EbonyWood.description: Wood from persimmon trees. Ebony wood is easy to polish, and is often used in sculptures. A raw stick of ebony wood can be used as a weapon in a pinch.
